pairs: And as they were approaching Jerusalem and Bethania,
he sent two of his disciples,
Ite in castellum, quod contra vos est,
“Go into the village that is opposite you,
you will find a colt tied,
super quem nemo adhuc hominum sedit:
on which no man has yet sat.
And if anyone will say to you:
Say that the Lord has need of him.
And he will immediately send him here.”
Et abeuntes invenerunt pullum ligatum ante januam foris in bivio:
And going out, they found the colt tied before the outer gate, at the meeting of two ways.
Et quidam de illic stantibus dicebant illis:
And some of those who were standing there said to them,
“What are you doing by releasing the colt?”
Qui dixerunt eis sicut præceperat illis Jesus,
And they spoke to them just as Jesus had instructed them.
And they led the colt to Jesus.
And they placed their garments on it;
Multi autem vestimenta sua straverunt in via:
Then many spread their garments along the way;
alii autem frondes cædebant de arboribus,
but others cut down leafy branches from trees
and scattered them on the way.
Hosanna: benedictus qui venit in nomine Domini:
Blessed is he who has arrived in the name of the Lord.
benedictum quod venit regnum patris nostri David:
Blessed is the advent of the kingdom of our father David.
And he entered into Jerusalem, into the temple.
And having looked around at everything,
since it was now the evening hour,
he went out to Bethania with the twelve.
Et alia die cum exirent a Bethania,
And the next day, as they were departing from Bethania,
Cumque vidisset a longe ficum habentem folia,
And when he had seen a fig tree with leaves in the distance,
venit si quid forte inveniret in ea:
he went to it, in case he might find something on it.
And when he had gone to it,
For it was not the season for figs.
And in response, he said to it,
Jam non amplius in æternum ex te fructum quisquam manducet.
“From now on and forever, may no one eat fruit from you again!”
And when he had entered into the temple,
cœpit ejicere vendentes et ementes in templo:
he began to cast out the sellers and the buyers in the temple.
et mensas numulariorum, et cathedras vendentium columbas evertit:
And he overturned the tables of the moneychangers and the chairs of the vendors of doves.
et non sinebat ut quisquam transferret vas per templum:
And he would not permit anyone to carry goods through the temple.
Quia domus mea, domus orationis vocabitur omnibus gentibus?
‘For my house shall be called the house of prayer for all nations?’
vos autem fecistis eam speluncam latronum.
But you have made it into a den of robbers.”
Quo audito principes sacerdotum et scribæ,
And when the leaders of the priests, and the scribes,
quærebant quomodo eum perderent: timebant enim eum,
had heard this, they sought a means by which they might destroy him.
quoniam universa turba admirabatur super doctrina ejus.
For they feared him, because the entire multitude was in admiration over his doctrine.
And when they passed by in the morning,
viderunt ficum aridam factam a radicibus.
they saw that the fig tree had dried up from the roots.
the fig tree that you cursed has withered.”
And in response, Jesus said to them:
that whoever will say to this mountain,
et non hæsitaverit in corde suo,
and who will not have hesitated in his heart,
then whatever he has said be done,
it shall be done for him.
For this reason, I say to you,
all things whatsoever that you ask for when praying:
believe that you will receive them,
and they will happen for you.
And when you stand to pray,
dimittite si quid habetis adversus aliquem:
if you hold anything against anyone,
may also forgive you your sins.
But if you will not forgive,
And they went again to Jerusalem.
And when he was walking in the temple,
“By what authority do you do these things?
et quis dedit tibi hanc potestatem ut ista facias?
And who has given you this authority, so that you would do these things?”
Interrogabo vos et ego unum verbum,
“I also will ask you one word,
et dicam vobis in qua potestate hæc faciam.
I will tell you by what authority I do these things.
But they discussed it among themselves,
‘Then why did you not believe him?’
omnes enim habebant Joannem quia vere propheta esset.
For they all hold that John was a true prophet.”
And answering, they said to Jesus,
And in response, Jesus said to them,
Neque ego dico vobis in qua potestate hæc faciam.
“Neither will I tell you by what authority I do these things.”
